title: Transfer of Property Act, 1882 — Section 12 (Condition making interest determinable on insolvency or attempted alienation)

content.overview: Where property is transferred subject to a condition that an interest shall cease on the transferee's insolvency or attempted alienation, the condition is void if the transferee is not thereby disentitled to the whole interest.
